answer_1.quote: We generate artificial data for each of these tasks in 11 typologically diverse languages...
answer_1.outputs: synthetic text samples for training downstream models

answer_2.quote: We fine-tune and evaluate 10 models for each configuration and report macro F1 scores averaged across 10 runs.

answer_3.quote: We use an LLM to revise and filter out "bad examples" by prompting with the intent description and previously generated samples.

answer_4.quote: Another limitation of this work is the lack of human annotations for checking the quality of the generated data.
